prompt:
A desktop landing page for 3D Hologram Ads, a business that sells holographic LED fan displays to small shops and bars, rendered edge to edge with crisp readable text, no browser window or device around it. The visitor is a shop owner deciding whether to buy and must be able to request a quote.

Premium hardware product page at the craft level of an Apple or Dyson product page. White text, one cyan accent. Top nav: 3D HOLOGRAM ADS with links How it works, In the wild, The kit, Prices, and a cyan Get a quote.

Headline-led and product-led at once. Centered near the top, the headline Your logo, floating in mid-air. Under it one line: Holographic LED fan with custom 3D content for liquor stores, donut shops, juice bars and phone shops. Two actions: a cyan button Request a quote and a plain link See it in the wild. Below, the 42 cm holographic LED fan straight on at life scale, its two thin LED blades a faint blur, and a glowing 3D liquor bottle floating in front of the hub with no screen behind it. The background of this whole hero is a real environment that matches the selected niche: a dim back bar at night, bottles on lit shelves, out of focus, darkened so the white text stays legible. Thin callout lines to Two-blade rotor and Clear acrylic cover. Directly under the fan a segmented switcher of four niche tabs: Liquor store (active, cyan underline with a short progress bar), Donut shop, Juice bar, Phone shop; the product and the background change with the tab. At the bottom edge, on a near-black band, a calm specs strip: Ø 42 cm, 1024 × 800 px, 224 LEDs, 150° viewing, 20 W, and the start of the next section, three offer cards Fan + cover $250, Content $150, Tripod $99.

Not a poster: a working web page with legible links, text and buttons.
approval: User approved the combined comp (headline-led + product-led with a four-niche switcher) and asked that the background follow the selected niche; this revision adds the bar environment for the liquor-store state. Quote: 'I approve, but with addition where the backrgound also follow the product, like when pick liquor the background will also change to a bar and so on'.
